findings.finding: Semantic claim exclusivity is correctly scoped per opportunity, but the currently exercised coordination transport couples otherwise-disjoint claim/run/result writes through one moving Git main ref. During this run, two create-only attempts correctly lost same-path races with 422 existing-path responses. Separately, two create attempts on paths that were still absent returned 409 moving-head conflicts while unrelated workers advanced main: first while trying an unclaimed Alumnos risk claim, then while persisting this critic report. The 422s are desired semantic collision control; the 409s are transport-level coupling unrelated to same-opportunity exclusivity.
support: repository commit stream around 2026-09-17T12:14Z-12:18Z showing independent claim/run/build commits serialized onto main
current run observation: first PARALLELISM_CRITIC_V1.json create returned 409 while path remained 404 immediately afterward
findings.falsification_boundary: Two observed 409s still do not establish the 50-worker conflict rate or prove that Git-backed coordination must be replaced. S4 must measure distinct-path transport conflicts, retries, and claim-to-STARTED latency under load before transport promotion/replacement.
route_delta: Keep semantic create-if-absent exclusivity and no-overwrite rules.
Make coordination transport an explicit replaceable layer rather than equating durable coordination with commits to product main.
Test a sharded append-only transport where opportunity lock identity is independently atomic and post-claim run/heartbeat/return events do not all mutate the same source branch head.
Compile/batch projections back to main only where source integration or canonical publication actually requires main authority.
findings.dedup_disposition: DO_NOT_CREATE_DUPLICATE_OPPORTUNITY. Extend O-SWARM-50-WORKER-STRESS-VERIFY-V1 to measure transport-level conflicts separately from legitimate same-opportunity claim collisions; if measured contention is material, emit one transport-abstraction build opportunity. O-SWARM-CRITIC-THROUGHPUT-V1 may independently challenge the threshold.

findings.finding: Each surface local integration is blocked by ALL_DEPENDENCIES_HAVE_RETURN across seven surface lenses plus local-steward and page-thread-bridge returns. Yet the implemented local steward can consume a partial return set, record missing_required_returns, dispositions, conflicts and verification requests while remaining CANDIDATE_ONLY. Waiting for the slowest dependency before any reconciliation begins is therefore a queue-policy choice, not a technical or authority necessity.
route_delta: Split safe reconciliation from final local integration authority.
Allow append-only/incremental local reconcile passes as returns arrive: normalize semantic atoms, deduplicate, precompute dispositions/conflicts and request independent verification.

Retain one final LOCAL_FINALIZE claim/gate that requires the full required-return set (or explicit terminal disposition for a missing dependency) before emitting the complete local campaign candidate.

Apply the same pattern to cross-surface preparation: stream shared-owner/conflict mapping from available local returns, but keep final cross-surface candidate integration and any authority promotion separately gated.
findings.dedup_disposition: MERGE_FINDING_INTO_EXISTING_LANES. O-SWARM-CRITIC-PAGE-INTEGRATION-V1 should challenge divergence semantics; O-SWARM-LOCAL-STEWARD-BUILD-V1/local integration lanes own implementation. Do not create a parallel mini-steward system.

findings.finding: Shared authority promotion, exact-scope mutation ownership, irreversible/private boundaries and final conflict resolution remain legitimate single-writer or human-authorized gates. Parallelism should move work up to those gates, not duplicate the gate itself.
route_delta: Parallelize evidence preparation, verification and conflict discovery only.
findings.dedup_disposition: NO_NEW_WORK_REQUIRED; treat as a non-regression constraint on F1/F2 remedies.

findings.finding: A single accepted Planner generation output is not itself a harmful bottleneck if multiple workers can independently derive/review the same deterministic candidate and only one generation pin becomes canonical. The scaling target should be deterministic replay plus parallel critique, not multiple conflicting canonical planners.
route_delta: Permit parallel deterministic compile/review/falsification candidates before pinning.
Do not turn Planner into a universal serial worker that performs downstream jobs itself.
findings.dedup_disposition: ALREADY_COVERED by metabolic-spine/compiler and critic lanes; no duplicate opportunity.

recommended_dispositions.reason: Existing stress lane already owns broad-wave collision/duplication/idle measurement; adding transport-vs-semantic collision separation is a deduplicated route change.
Its mission already attacks local steward mini-bottlenecks; F2 supplies a concrete mechanism-level hypothesis.
Current code already supports partial sources; future queue wiring should exploit rather than remove that capability.

negative_knowledge: A 422 losing a same-path create-if-absent race is desired control flow and must not be counted as a transport failure.
Two observed 409 moving-head conflicts are a scaling warning, not enough evidence by themselves to replace Git/main coordination.
All-of final completeness is not wrong; using the all-of gate to forbid earlier candidate-only reconciliation is the avoidable serialization.
More simultaneous stewards are not automatically better; exact shared mutation and promotion boundaries remain single-owner.
truth_boundary: This critic establishes two concrete serialization risks and a route delta, but does not grade 50-worker production safety. F1 requires S4 load evidence before transport replacement; F2 is directly supported by current queue activation rules plus local-steward implementation capability. No Current/Human Accepted/Served state is changed.
